name: Runway
oneLiner: One ledger, one burn line, one number.
headline: Where the money goes, and
problem: Small teams leak cash in dozens of small bills and can't say at a glance how many months are left. Runway is one ledger, one burn line, one number.
built: A web rebuild of the original tool: every outgoing amount in one ledger, a burn line, and the number of days left at the current rate.
changed: In progress. The web version is being rebuilt in this stack; the number that matters is the days-left figure on the first screen.
whatItDoes: Every outgoing dollar in one table. Transfers excluded from spend. A forward line shows the lowest cash point in the next 180 days.
underTheHood: Postgres with row-level security, server actions, magic-link auth, Playwright on every PR.

brand.lede: One ledger for every account. One burn line. One number: how many months you have left at this pace.

name: This site
oneLiner: This portfolio. Data file in, rooms out.
headline: One dataset,
problem: A portfolio usually shows one layout. Ten were drawn, and choosing one throws away nine.
built: One JSON file describes every project. Each room is a renderer over that file, so projects can be added without touching components. The design system lives in the same repo.
changed: Live. Rooms by platform, a dock that follows scroll, and a fishing game that opens projects.

brand.lede: One data file of projects, rendered as rooms. Change the file, the site follows. You are standing in it.

name: Dekk
oneLiner: Plays what you own. No account.
headline: A local-files music player,
problem: Placeholder. Music you bought sits in files no streaming app will play without an account and a subscription.
built: Placeholder. An iPhone player that reads the files on the device, builds a library, and plays them with a queue and shuffle.
changed: Placeholder. On TestFlight, shared freely. App Store next.

brand.lede: Plays the music files you already own. Drop them in, build playlists, press play. No account, no subscription.

name: Divot
oneLiner: Scores plus side bets, settled after the round.
headline: Golf scorecard and
problem: Placeholder. A foursome keeps score on paper and settles skins from memory in the parking lot.
built: Placeholder. A scorecard that tracks every hole and every side bet, then settles the round.
changed: Placeholder. On TestFlight with a few regular groups.

brand.lede: Keeps every player's score and settles the bets when you walk off 18. Skins, closest to pin, stroke play, all at once.

name: Regiment
oneLiner: Library of exercises, build workouts, run multi-week programs. Supersets first.
headline: Programs and routines for hybrid athletes
problem: Placeholder. Workout apps treat a superset as two exercises in a row. Hybrid programs need rounds, circuits, and per-exercise overrides.
built: Placeholder. An exercise library, workouts built from it, and multi-week programs with every day editable.

brand.lede: Build workouts from a real exercise library. Stack them into a four-week program. Follow it at the gym without staring at your phone.

name: Snaphour
oneLiner: One shot, Live Photo, or clip per hour block. Fill it live or later.
headline: A photo for
problem: Placeholder. A camera roll is a pile. A day is twenty-four hours, and most of them leave no trace.
built: Placeholder. A day view of hour blocks; tap one to fill it with a photo, Live Photo, or clip. Describe it instead and Image Playground draws it.
changed: Placeholder. Running on my phone. Shared days over CloudKit are in progress.

features.title: 24 hour blocks
features.text: Day view, tap an hour to fill.

features.title: Shared days
features.text: Friends see each other's hours live.

brand.lede: One photo for every hour you're awake. Fill them in as you go or all at once at night. Friends see your day as it happens.

name: Skillet
oneLiner: Save recipes, cook them, shop for them in one list.
headline: Recipes and tracking,
problem: Placeholder. Recipes live in screenshots and bookmarks, and the shopping list gets rebuilt by hand every week.
built: Placeholder. A native iPhone recipe library with a cook mode and a combined shopping list across the recipes you pick.

features.title: One list
features.text: Pick recipes, get the merged list.

brand.lede: Save a recipe from anywhere. Pick a few for the week and it merges the ingredients into one shopping list.

name: Loot
oneLiner: Folders for clothing, tech, gear. Value, condition, rarity, boards.
headline: Everything you own,
problem: Placeholder. Nobody knows what they own, what it is worth, or where it is.
built: Placeholder. A catalog with nested folders, cutout photos, value and condition fields, and outfit boards.

brand.lede: A catalog of what you have. Clothing, tech, gear, in folders. Value, condition, rarity, boards.

name: Mail Room
oneLiner: Buckets every message by what it needs from you.
headline: An inbox that
problem: Email piles up faster than anyone reads it. Mail Room buckets every message by what it needs from you, syncs the result back to Gmail, and drafts the reply.
built: A native Mac app that reads the inbox and sorts each message into a bucket, so the person only reads what is left.
changed: Mail Room stays native. This page is the case study; a short video and a link to the app follow when they are ready.
whatItDoes: Five views on one inbox: feed, days, buckets, reply board, calendar. AI classifies, you confirm, Gmail labels update.
underTheHood: SwiftUI, Gmail API, on-device classification cache, background sync.

brand.lede: Every message lands in a bucket by what it needs from you. Reply, read, wait, or nothing. Synced back to Gmail.

name: Company Log
oneLiner: Paste handles, a worker pulls every post with numbers.
headline: Every post a company makes,
problem: Marketing teams juggle five platforms and no single record. Paste a company's handles; a worker pulls every post with its numbers into one timeline.
built: Paste a company's social links; a scheduled worker collects every post into one feed. The scraper runs on a GitHub Actions cron and writes to Supabase.
changed: In progress. The scraper is the long pole; official APIs first, scraping as the fallback.
whatItDoes: Scheduled worker fetches, dedupes, and stores every post with likes, comments, views. Dashboard filters by platform, week, and format.
underTheHood: GitHub Actions cron, official APIs first, Postgres, Zod on every record.

brand.lede: Paste a company's handles. A worker pulls every post from every platform, with the numbers, into one log.
